patch_description: Replace the second ZZZ block from [1,5,6] to [2,5,8] to explore alternative three-qubit coupling patterns. This maintains the same parameter count and depth while testing whether a shifted triplet captures complementary high-order correlations that may improve generalization. The new configuration [0,4,8] and [2,5,8] provides better spatial distribution across the qubit lattice compared to [0,4,8] and [1,5,6], potentially capturing richer feature interactions without increasing model complexity.
